enchilada.line: This old porch is a steamin' greasy plate of enchiladas
stanza: This old porch is a steamin' greasy plate of enchiladas
With lots of cheese and onions and a guacamole salad
You can get them at the LaSalle Hotel in old downtown
With iced tea and a waitress who will smile every time, yeah she will
I left a quarter tip on my ten dollar bill

nevada.line: Keep going til we hit Reno, Nevada"
stanza: Remember Andy standing outside your bedroom window
Saying “Come on, let’s drive across to the Palisades
Keep going til we hit Reno, Nevada"
I don't see Andy all that much these days
